prompt: launch video for a note-taking app

plan.title: A Note App That Keeps Up With Your Thoughts
plan.description: A 30-second launch video for a new note-taking app built to capture ideas the moment they appear. See how quick capture and simple search keep every thought easy to find.

beats.narration: Your best idea can slip away fast. Then it's gone. Meet the note app that catches thoughts before they disappear.

props.text: Catch every thought before it's gone.

beats.narration: Open it, type or speak, done. Getting started takes almost no effort.
Later, just search. Your ideas are easy to find again. Start writing today, and never lose a thought again.

warnings: length: the narration totals 64 words in 3 beats but a 30-second video needs about 58 (between 52 and 58). Cut about 6 words: 3 to 4 beats of about 19 words each (you averaged 21; count the words of every beat), one idea, no preamble and no recap; keep the hook and the last line
grounding: 3 beats had unsupported specifics, 3 rewritten
